Durable widgets for small repair shops

Acme Widgets has made steel widgets since 1998. Every widget is cut, bent and finished in one shop, then tested under load before it ships. Small repair shops use them to fix doors, gates, shelves and machines without waiting on a big supplier. We keep three sizes in stock all year: small, medium and large. Each size comes in plain steel or a black powder coat. Bulk orders of fifty or more ship free inside the country, and we answer every email within one working day. If a widget fails under normal use in the first five years, we replace it. That's the whole warranty.

Sizes and prices

Small widgets cost four dollars, medium widgets cost six dollars and large widgets cost nine dollars. Prices drop ten percent on orders over two hundred units. You can order online, by phone or by email, and we send tracking numbers the same day your order leaves the shop. Custom sizes take two weeks and start at one hundred units.

How to order

Pick a size and finish, add the number you need and check out. Shops that order every month can set up an account with net thirty terms after the third order. Questions about fit or load ratings go straight to the people who make the widgets, not a call center.
